newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK BROKER REPS RETURN TO ECON MINISTRY TALKS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK BROKER REPS RETURN TO ECON MINISTRY TALKS.

text.p: Representatives of the Greek stockbrokers association returned to their late night talks with national economy ministry officials aimed at resolving a row over settlements with the bourse's clearing house.
The row erupted after Delta Securities was charged with fraud last week. The brokers have refused to trade for two days, virtually closing the Athens stock exchange.

"We made some suggestions. It is a developing process. We hope a solution will be found," the president of the Association of Athens Stock Exchange Members (SMEHA), Panagiotis Kondalexis told reporters.
Kondalexis and other SMEHA representatives then returned to the talks at the ministry. --Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
